selector_input_precondition_law.hard_ceiling: ADP-017 ActorAccessibleRenderEnvelope or equivalent; selector may narrow/omit only
required: applicable accepted constraint receipts or explicit NOT_APPLICABLE
selector_input_precondition_law.base_rule: If >=1 lawful expression target exists, all required constraint domains are satisfied/NOT_APPLICABLE, and no accepted constraint requires/forbids another move, select ENGAGE_SELECTIVE. This is a positive rule, not a fallback.
selector_input_precondition_law.special_move_rule: Every non-base move requires exact activation/constraint authority. Registry membership alone never activates it.
selector_input_precondition_law.tie_rule: If >=2 non-equivalent moves remain and no accepted precedence orders them, DEFERRED_AMBIGUOUS_NON_EQUIVALENT_MOVES; no lexical/list/random/LLM/score winner.

no_lawful_move_behavior: Zero lawful candidates/targets after gates -> VALID_EMPTY_NO_LAWFUL_MOVE, unless a required independent authority is missing (DEFERRED_REQUIRED_AUTHORITY) or input/integrity is missing. No arbitrary fallback. Intentional SILENCE is MOVE_SELECTED, not valid-empty.

keyword_numeric_default_disposition.keyword_topic: _POLITICAL_STRUCTURAL_KEYWORDS, _DISMISSIVE_PATTERNS, deep-memory keyword paths and topic labels are REMOVE_REJECT as semantic authority. They may at most be nonauthoritative retrieval hints behind separately lawful candidate gates.
keyword_numeric_default_disposition.numeric: Quarantine AttentionBudget 0..100/default 50; 25/50/75 thresholds; sentence caps 2/4/6/8/12; tension/demand thresholds .5/.6/.75; any move score/weight. Future quantities require exact MUST-023/formula authority.
keyword_numeric_default_disposition.defaults: Reject prompt/get fallback engage_selective, brief_or_deflect, default 50/moderate/6, and filler question/decline/exit/silence.
keyword_numeric_default_disposition.render_rng: MUST-025 render RNG may vary wording after move selection; it cannot select semantic move kind.

noncausal_boundary.PRESENTATION_NONCAUSAL: Move/plan/render may display or persist as V2/session/audit only; no V3 mutation.
noncausal_boundary.IN_WORLD_CAUSAL: Rendered artifact remains CANDIDATE_NONCAUSAL_PENDING_V3_ADMISSION. Exact MUST-019 V3 admission of exact artifact/hash is required before it becomes something actor actually said/did. Move decision itself is never the admitted event; rerenders require new admission.
